message.content: The “best” movie of 2020 can vary depending on who you ask—critics, audiences, or specific award bodies—but one film that consistently topped lists and received widespread acclaim was **“Parasite”** (though it was released in 2019, it dominated 2020 awards season). If you’re looking for a 2020 release that many consider the standout of that year, **“Tenet”** (directed by Christopher Nolan) was a major blockbuster that sparked intense discussion and debate. For a more universally praised 2020 original, **“Soul”** from Pixar was celebrated for its heartfelt storytelling and musical score. Ultimately, the “best” movie depends on your taste—whether you prefer genre, storytelling, or cultural impact.
